title: 第21章 螳螂捕蝉黄雀在后第22章 希娅的加入
slug: 你好是寄往魔神堡垒的信吗
lines: 就在希娅背着林鬼、扛着背包，拼命向着森林外围冲刺的同时。
森林深处的洼地，已然化作血腥的炼狱。
莫拉格斯彻底苏醒，滔天的怨气，混合着传奇恶魔的恐怖威压，如同海啸般爆发。
将剩余的骑士团成员压得几乎窒息，牙齿不住地打颤。
那名被强征来的公会斥候面色惨白如纸。
看着周围如同潮水般涌来的恶魔和那尊恐怖的巨物。
声音带着哭腔对里昂喊道。
“骑士长！恶魔潮！恶魔潮来了！我们为什么不跑啊？！”
就在刚才，他想要独自逃命时，却被身旁一名骑士死死拽住了胳膊。
就在这时，骑士团中那名一直沉默寡言的刺客，眼中闪过一丝决绝。
猛地从怀中掏出一枚散发着幽幽绿芒、不祥气息的宝石。
当他将宝石紧紧按在胸口时。
一股精纯而浓郁的恶魔气息，竟猛地从他体内散发出来！
他强忍着源自灵魂的战栗，双腿剧烈颤抖着。
一步步走向那即将彻底暴走的传奇恶魔，莫拉格斯。
在莫拉格斯毁灭性的攻击，降临前最后一刻。
他“噗通”一声重重跪倒在泥泞的地面上。
用尽全身力气，声音嘶哑地大喊：
“伟大的传奇恶魔大人！请息怒！是我！是前段时间为您献计的那个人！”
“咯咯咯~~献计？”
莫拉格斯庞大的身躯微微一顿。
那对绿油油的、充满无尽恶意的眼睛死死锁定刺客。
树干上扭曲的人脸发出嘲弄的声音。
“哦~原来是你这只狡猾的小虫子啊~告诉我哪里能找到更多‘气球’的小东西~”
“对！对对！就是我！就是我！”
刺客如同抓住了唯一的救命稻草，狂喜地连连磕头。
“我是您的同伴！我们是朋友啊！”
“那刚刚……打扰我沉睡的~~也是你？！”
莫拉格斯的声音陡然变得冰冷刺骨。
刚刚稍有收敛的恐怖威压再次轰然爆发，如同山岳般压向刺客！
刺客深知此事根本无法辩解，只能豁出去了，扯着嗓子大吼道。
“伟大的莫拉格斯大人！我为您带来了祭品！新的、更丰厚的祭品！”
“祭品？”
这个词仿佛带着奇异的魔力，莫拉格斯那狂暴的气势果然微微一滞。
它巨大的眼睛掠过刺客。
扫向他身后那支，虽然减员但依旧散发着不凡气息的骑士团。
尤其是为首的里昂。
感受着那近十个超凡强者体内蕴含的“美味”力量，它顿时激动地大叫起来。
树干上所有的人脸，都露出了贪婪而扭曲的笑容：
“天呐！咯咯咯~你竟然给我带来了这么多丰厚的祭品！”
“你确实是我……忠实的朋友~我该如何奖赏你呢？我亲爱的朋友~咯咯咯~~”
刺客脸上的狂喜笑容瞬间僵住，奖赏？
他猛地回头，看向里昂，眼中闪过一丝狠厉与催促。
里昂瞬间读懂了他的眼神，面色一寒。
冰冷的目光如同毒蛇般，锁定了那名还在震惊和恐惧中的公会斥候。
content_en:
While Shia was carrying the forest ghost and backpack, she was sprinting towards the outskirts of the forest.
The depression deep in the forest has turned into a bloody purgatory.
Moragos woke up completely, and his overwhelming resentment, mixed with the terrifying pressure of the legendary demon, erupted like a tsunami.
The remaining members of the Knights were almost suffocated, and their teeth kept chattering.
The guild scout who was forcibly recruited looked as pale as a sheet of paper.
Looking at the demons and the terrifying giant coming in like a tide around him.
The voice was crying and shouted to Leon.
"Knight Commander! Demon Tide! Demon Tide is coming! Why don't we run?!"
Just now, when he wanted to escape alone, he was grabbed by the arm by a knight beside him.
At this moment, the assassin in the Knights, who had always been silent, had a trace of determination in his eyes.
He suddenly took out a gem that exuded a faint green light and an ominous aura from his arms.
as he held the gem tightly to his chest.
A pure and rich demonic aura suddenly emanated from his body!
He suppressed the trembling from his soul, and his legs trembled violently.
Step by step towards the legendary demon, Moragos, who is about to go completely berserk.
The last moment before Moragos' devastating attack arrives.
He fell to his knees heavily on the muddy ground with a thud.
Using all his strength, he yelled hoarsely:
"The great legendary demon! Please calm down! It's me! I'm the one who gave you advice some time ago!"
"Kekeke~~ Offer some advice?"
Moragos' huge body paused slightly.
Those green eyes, full of endless malice, were locked on the assassin.
The twisted human faces on the tree trunks made mocking sounds.
"Oh~ So it's you, a cunning little bug~ Tell me where I can find more 'balloon' things~"
"Yes! Yes! It's me! It's me!"
The assassin seemed to have grasped the only life-saving straw and kowtowed in ecstasy.
"I am your companion! We are friends!"
"Then...it was you who disturbed my sleep just now~~?!"
Moragos' voice suddenly turned cold and biting.
The terrifying coercion that had just subsided suddenly exploded again, pressing on the assassin like a mountain!
The assassin knew that there was no excuse for this matter, so he could only risk it and shouted at the top of his lungs.
"Great Lord Moragos! I bring you sacrifices! New and richer sacrifices!"
"Sacrifice?"
This word seemed to have a strange magic power, and Moragos' violent momentum was indeed slightly stagnant.
Its huge eyes glanced over the assassin.
He glanced at the knights behind him. Although they were reduced in number, they still exuded an extraordinary aura.
Especially Lyon, the leader.
Feeling the "delicious" power contained in the bodies of the nearly ten extraordinary strong men, it suddenly shouted excitedly.
All the faces on the tree trunks showed greedy and twisted smiles:
"Oh my god! Geez! You actually brought me so many generous sacrifices!"
"You are indeed my...loyal friend~How should I reward you? My dear friend~giggle~~"
The ecstatic smile on the assassin's face froze instantly, reward?
He turned back sharply and looked at Leon, with a hint of fierceness and urging flashing in his eyes.
Leon instantly understood his eyes and his face turned cold.
His cold gaze was like a poisonous snake, locking on the guild scout who was still in shock and fear.
